title: Personal Care and Respite Hours Schedule, LTSS Service Coordination
content:
Within Care Management, personal care and respite hours are a benefit of LTSS Service Coordination: it is the only tier whose schedule authorizes any hours. The schedule sets the weekly and daily limits, the length of one authorization period, whether unused hours carry forward, the billing increment, the yearly respite allowance and the notice owed before authorized hours are reduced.

## Schedule by tier

| Care Management tier | Most personal care hours authorized per week | Most personal care hours delivered in one day | Authorization period (days) | Unused hours carry into the next period | Billing increment (minutes) | Respite hours per calendar year | Advance written notice before hours are reduced (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Healthy Living Support | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | No | 0 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Care Coordination Level 1 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | No | 0 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Care Coordination Level 2 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | No | 0 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Maternal Care Management | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | No | 0 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Complex Case Management | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | No | 0 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Health Home Services | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | No | 0 | 0.00 | 0 |
| LTSS Service Coordination | 40.00 | 12.00 | 7 | No | 15 | 240.00 | 10 |

## Terms of the schedule

- Hours are stated to two decimal places.
- An authorization period of 7 days is a Monday to Sunday week; 0 means the period does not apply.
- A billing increment of 15 minutes means delivered hours are billed in quarter hours; 0 means the increment does not apply.
- In no tier do unused authorized hours carry into the next period.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- In LTSS Service Coordination, three days at the daily maximum of 12.00 hours come to 36.00 hours, 4.00 hours short of the weekly maximum of 40.00.
- A visit of 2 hours 45 minutes is eleven 15-minute increments, or 2.75 hours.
- A member who has used 200.00 respite hours in a calendar year has 40.00 left of the 240.00 for that year.
- A reduction of authorized hours for an LTSS Service Coordination member needs 10 calendar days of advance written notice.
